 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-123 Year-2024 Thana- Naugachia District-

sentences.text:

 1. Md. Javed Son of Md. Rasul Resident of Village- Simra Kurab Tola, P.S.
 Naugachia, Distt.- Bhagalpur
 2. Rubi Khatoon Wife of Md. Javed Resident of Village- Simra Kurab Tola,
 P.S.- Naugachia, Distt.- Bhagalpur
 ...

... Petitione
 Versus
 1. The State of Bihar
 2. Hajra Begum Wife of Md. Imran Resident of Village- Simra Ward No. 06,
 P.S.- Naugachia, Distt.- Bhagalpur
 ... ... Opposite Part
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Akshay Kumar
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ashok Kumar Singh
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Justice Smt. Soni Shrivastava
 Oral Order
4 11-04-2025 Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned APP for the State.
2. The present application is for grant of anticipatory bail, in connection with Naugachia P.S. Case No.123 of 2024 for offences under Sections 498A, 323, 379 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. From the perusal of the First Information Report, it would appear that the petitioners along with other co-accused persons instigated the husband of the informant to inflict cruelty upon her.
The present petitioners are the father-in-law and mother- in-law of the informant/victim.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are living separately from the husband of the informant and have no concern with the family affairs of the informant.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.79360 of 2024(4) dt.11-04-2025
Moreover, the allegations are general and omnibus in nature and are specific to some extent against the husband of the informant, who is primarily responsible for the welfare of his wife.
5. Learned APP for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail application.

6. Considering that the petitioners, above named are the father-in-law and mother-in-law of the informant and also considering the fact that both are old aged persons, let the petitioners, in the event of their arrest or surrender before the Court below within four weeks, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the Md. Javed vs The State Of Bihar on 11 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15670560/
1 satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, 1st Naugachia, in connection with Naugachia P.S.
Case No.123 of 2024, subject to the condition laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure/Section 482 (2) of the B.N.S.S., 2023 and subject to the further condition that the petitioner shall co-operate in the investigation/trial.
